table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	NTNo=C.NTNNo,
	STRNO=C.SalestaxRegNo,
	AliasName = A.AliasName,
	Customer = A.Name,
	RefNo = S.CustRefNo,
	Date = S.Date,
	Rate = MAX(D.GSTPerc),
	Qty = SUM(D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty),
	Weight = SUM((D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * I.UnitWeight),
	ValueExTax = SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)),
	SalesTax = ROUND(SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.GSTPerc * 0.01), 2),
	ExtraTax = SUM((D.LooseQty + D.Bonusqty) * D.UnitSalesTax)
FROM 
	SaleLedger S, SaleDetail D, Customer C, Accounts A, Item I
WHERE
	S.Posted='Y' AND
	S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	S.SaleInvcode = D.SaleInvCode AND
	S.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode 
GROUP BY
	C.NTNNo,
	C.SalestaxRegNo,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	S.CustRefNo,
	S.SaleInvCode,
	S.Date
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	NTNo=C.NTNNo,
	STRNO=C.SalestaxRegNo,
	AliasName = A.AliasName,
	Customer = A.Name,
	RefNo = S.CustRefNo,
	Date = S.Date,
	Rate = MAX(D.GSTPerc),
	Qty = SUM(D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty),
	Weight = SUM((D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * I.UnitWeight),
	ValueExTax = SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)),
	SalesTax = ROUND(SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.GSTPerc * 0.01), 2),
	ExtraTax = SUM((D.LooseQty + D.Bonusqty) * D.UnitSalesTax)
FROM 
	CRS_SaleLedger S, CRS_SaleDetail D, Customer C, Accounts A, Item I
WHERE
	S.ClientInstanceID = D.ClientInstanceID AND
	S.Posted='Y' AND
	S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	S.SaleInvcode = D.SaleInvCode AND
	S.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode 
GROUP BY
	S.ClientInstanceID,
	C.NTNNo,
	C.SalestaxRegNo,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	S.CustRefNo,
	S.SaleInvCode,
	S.Date

objects.name: compute_6
objects.expression: sum( valueextax + salestax + extratax  for all)
